content.title: About this service
content.body: Intervalify is an interval ear-training application. Information about the bundled sounds and their licenses is available on the Sounds & credits page.

overview.title: Overview
overview.body: Intervalify works without an account. The application does not include advertising, analytics, tracking pixels or a cloud database. Your answers are processed on your device. Scores and language preferences are not sent to the operator by the application. Visiting the hosted website still involves technical data processing by the hosting provider, as described below.

storage.title: Progress, language and offline storage
storage.body: Intervalify stores your best scores, stars and unlocked levels locally under intervalify.progress.v1. Your language preference is stored separately under intervalify.language.v1. Your tutorial preference is stored under intervalify.tutorial.hidden.v1. The device or browser language is read to select the initial interface language. On the web, a service worker also caches application files and audio for offline use. These functions provide the game, remember your settings and enable offline playback; their legal basis is Article 6(1)(b) GDPR. Access to device storage for these requested functions is based on Section 25(2)(2) TDDDG. No advertising or analytics cookies are set by the application. Local records remain until you clear the app or website data, uninstall the app, or the browser removes them. Clearing this data also deletes your saved progress. There is no cloud backup.

hosting.title: Website hosting with Cloudflare
hosting.body: The web version is intended to be hosted through Cloudflare Workers, provided by Cloudflare, Inc., 101 Townsend St., San Francisco, CA 94107, USA. When you access the website, Cloudflare processes technical request data such as your IP address, requested URL, access time and browser/device information to deliver and protect the site. The legal basis is Article 6(1)(f) GDPR: the legitimate interest in secure and reliable delivery. Processing may take place outside the EU/EEA, including in the USA. Cloudflare describes international-transfer safeguards and its processing in the privacy policy linked below. Technical data retention depends on the hosting/security configuration and applicable Cloudflare terms; it is separate from your locally stored game progress.

contact.title: Email enquiries
contact.body: If you contact the operator by email, your email address, message and any details you include are processed to answer your enquiry. The legal basis is Article 6(1)(b) GDPR for enquiries concerning a contract or Article 6(1)(f) GDPR for other enquiries, based on the interest in responding to correspondence. Messages are kept only as long as needed to handle the enquiry, subject to any statutory retention obligations.

rights.title: Your rights
rights.body: Where the legal requirements are met, you have rights of access, rectification, erasure, restriction of processing and data portability. You may object to processing based on legitimate interests under Article 21 GDPR and withdraw any consent for future processing. Contact the operator using the details above. You may also complain to a data protection supervisory authority, including the State Commissioner for Data Protection and Freedom of Information of Rhineland-Palatinate. Local game data can be deleted directly through your device or browser settings; the operator cannot retrieve it remotely.
